title: Tax Compliance Services
summary: GST, TDS and income tax in India; VAT and corporate tax in the UAE; VAT, Zakat and e-invoicing in Saudi Arabia.
metaTitle: Tax Compliance Services: India, UAE and Saudi Arabia
metaDescription: Tax compliance for businesses in India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia: GST, TDS, income tax, UAE VAT and corporate tax, KSA VAT, Zakat and ZATCA e-invoicing.
heroIntro: Local tax compliance, done on time and reconciled to your books, in India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia.
overview:
Tax compliance works best when it is built into your monthly close rather than done in a rush before a deadline. Every client gets a compliance calendar for each registration they hold, reminders before every due date and a confirmation once the return is filed.

Filings are scoped at onboarding to what applies to your registrations. In the Gulf, returns are submitted through your own portal accounts or a licensed tax agent where representation is required; we prepare, reconcile and walk you through approval.
whatWeDo: Build a compliance calendar for every registration you hold.
Prepare returns and reconcile them to your ledgers.
Remind you before each due date and confirm once filed.
Track input tax credits, withholding and advance tax.
Run periodic tax health reviews on higher tiers.
Prepare data and draft responses for tax notices and queries.

byPlan.foundation: Filings, reconciliation and an annual tax planning review.
byPlan.cfo: Quarterly tax planning review and impact review on new products and contracts.

note: Statutory audit and tax audit are performed by an independent auditor appointed by you. We prepare everything the auditor needs.

faqs.a: In India: GST, TDS and income tax. In the UAE: VAT and corporate tax. In Saudi Arabia: VAT, Zakat or income tax, withholding tax and ZATCA e-invoicing monitoring.

faqs.q: Do you file returns directly with the authorities?
faqs.a: In India we prepare and file returns as applicable to your registrations. In the UAE and Saudi Arabia, returns are submitted through your own portal accounts or a licensed tax agent where representation is required.

faqs.q: What if I have no GST or TDS obligation?
faqs.a: Filings are scoped at onboarding. If you do not have an obligation, you are not billed for it.
